skins.content:
Lappland's finest tailored clothes for when she takes the stage.
Meticulous craftsmanship and exquisite materials—Look how much she respects Siracusa's traditions.

skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
The Decadanza is her confession.
A silent howl resounds through the wilds, and she is the only one dancing with the wolves.

skins.name: Unruly Humbleness
skins.content: Test Collection Series/Unruly Humbleness. Bartender and bar-owner Lappland, with some of her colleagues in tow, happily welcomes in tonight's employer and Boss.

skins.quote: She will satisfy your every whim, free of charge, just like how you are doing your best to please her.
